Short title and commencement

ACT XVI OF 2020
ACT XVI OF 2020
DRUGS (SINDH AMENDMENT) ACT, 2020
An Act to amend the Drugs Act, 1976 (Act No. XXXI
of 1976),
in its application to the Province of Sindh
[Gazette of Sindh Extraordinary, Part IV,
12th August, 2020]
No.
PAS/LEGIS-B-08/2020, dated 12.8.2020.---The Drugs (Sindh Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 27th July, 2020 and assented to by the Governor
of Sindh on 05th August, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the Legislature
of Sindh.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient to amend the Drugs Act,
1976 (Act No. XXXI of 1976), in its application to the Province of Sindh, in
the manner hereinafter appearing:
It is
hereby enacted as follows:-
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Drugs (Sindh Amendment) Act, 2020.
(2) It shall
come into force at once.

2. Amendment
of section 31 Act XXXI of 1976.---In
the Drugs Act, 1976 (Act No.XXXI of 1976), in its application to the Province
of Sindh, in section 31 -
(i) for the
words "Federal Government", wherever occurring, the words
"Provincial Government" shall be substituted;
(ii) in subsection
(1), for the word "members", the words "full-time members"
shall be substituted.".
